page.overview:
Who is Spotlight Bugs?

The Spotlight Bugs are supporting characters in A Bug's Life.

"Lights! Two fireflies high on a platform have to stick their rumps into metal cones to shine spotlights on the circus ring. But it's a full job, and one of them is dozing between acts. His partner wakes him up with a smack that jolts his volts into action."
